data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1686's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 (closing balance at 31 December 2017) is shown as USD 309.841m (gross). The report does not present a clearly labelled gross prior-year movement figure in the available pages/images; no unambiguous gross prior-year release or strengthening amount could be located. Gross written premium for 2018 was USD 420.079m. Detailed per-line prior year reserve movements and a gross claims development triangle could not be reliably extracted from the supplied images.
data.data_quality_notes: Source documents are image scans with limited resolution. Opening gross claims outstanding (gross claims outstanding = provision for claims outstanding, insurance liabilities column) was read from the Insurance assets and liabilities table (Provision for claims outstanding) showing Gross = 309,841 (USD 000) for the prior year -> converted to 309.841 (millions). I could not find a clearly labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' showing a GROSS figure; the available triangle and notes in the images were not legible enough to extract a reliable gross prior-year development amount. The claims development table was present but the scan quality prevented safe extraction; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Segmental premium breakdown (regulatory class names and amounts) could not be reliably transcribed from the images, so gross_premium_mix is left empty. Amounts and page references reflect the pages visible in the provided images and may require verification against a higher-quality PDF.
